note: Per-item recovery oracle (thermite-design.md §4.3: 'a syntax error inside one item cannot cascade into the next; items are parsed independently — recovery is per-item by construction'). The first item `broken` omits the MANDATORY `ens` clause, which is a PARSE error (§4.1: a mandatory contract clause's absence is a parse error, never an implicit default). The parser must report that error AND still recover to parse the well-formed second item `ok`.
